_README: SYNTHETIC DEMO FIXTURES. Invented companies and people on .example domains. These stand in for the responses a live run would receive from the CRM, enrichment and the composition step; the demo's logic runs on them for real. Each planted case is named in _planted so a test can assert its hold appears.

_planted.cobalt.example: duplicate source row with a second signal: merged, both signals kept
_planted.northwind.example: already in the CRM: routed to update, never create
_planted.vantage.example: GTM team of 3 on a hiring signal: excluded
_planted.lumen.example: team state unknown: no motion assigned, held for the free people search
_planted.quarry.example: stale funding signal: pre-score Fair, account record only, no enrichment spend
_planted.meridian.example: enriched, then the full score drops it below Fair: no people spend
_planted.S. Lindqvist: catch-all address: held at the catch-all enrollment gate
_planted.E. Walsh: T3 with weak role fit: held
_planted.P. Anand: enrichment cascade never fired: field gate FAIL
_planted.R. Singh: opener carries a number no source supports: composition hold

Reading the RevOps Lead posting your team opened on 2026-08-25, the scope covers CRM hygiene and pipeline reporting in one seat. That reads as a build seat rather than a support seat.
